title: MCP grew beyond images
summary:
Assistants gained more ways to use Pollinations while model discovery, API behavior, and examples became easier to work with.

The MCP server gained tools for generating text, producing speech, speaking supplied text, and listing models and voices. Its package name and executable were corrected for npx installation, followed by Node.js 14 compatibility work in version 1.0.6.

The text API added mistral-roblox, phi-mini, and the Roblox-focused roblox-rp model. Qwen Coder gained an 8,000-token maximum, Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite moved to its non-preview model ID, and /openai/models stopped serving cached responses so model changes can appear without waiting for cache expiry.

SearchGPT cache entries now distinguish streaming from non-streaming requests. Malformed image flag values resolve to false, chat requests on OpenAI-compatible routes are marked private by default, and Cloudflare SDXL was restored as a fallback when Cloudflare Flux image generation fails.

New examples show JavaScript speech-to-text and Python and JavaScript Vision requests using local JPEGs. Audio, vision, and request-body examples were clarified; the docs also specify that the OpenAI-compatible text API currently supports only the completion endpoint. MCP installation and several documentation links received follow-up fixes.
